title: Vegan Apple Bread with Cinnamon Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: 1/2 cup unsweetened almond or oat milk
instructions: Mix together the apple sauce, butter, vanilla, maple syrup, and oat or almond milk. Add baking powder, cinnamon, and baking soda. Mix.

Add the oats and the oat flour and mix until combined. Pour the batter into a 9x5 loaf pan sprayed with baking spray. Optionally top with apple slices, or skip if topping with cinnamon cream cheese frosting.
Bake for about 30-40 minutes (depending on loaf pan type and oven).
Check doneness with a toothpick test. Serve immediately topped with cinnamon cream cheese icing.
notes: Originally shared as a Facebook reel from 'Peanut Butter and Jilly' with the recipe link hidden behind the video's 'See more' caption expander (not in the first comment as usual) — the caption read: 'For the recipe comment RECIPE and I'll message it to you or you can go right over to peanutbutterandjilly.com/easy-apple-bread/'. Recipe is vegan and gluten-free friendly (uses oat flour + oats). Can substitute 1 3/4 cup regular or gluten-free all-purpose flour for the oat flour if needed. To freeze: cool completely, wrap in plastic wrap, freeze 60-90 days. Store at room temp covered 2 days or fridge up to 5 days. Original reel: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1Hdgv4w55S/
